questions.question: The quarterly report has been delayed ______ the server outage.
questions.explanation: due to 表原因，后接名词短语，表示“由于”之意。

questions.question: ______ several attempts, the team could not resolve the network issue.
questions.explanation: Despite 后接名词短语表“尽管”，让步关系符合句意。

questions.question: All invoices ______ before the end of the month will receive a discount.
questions.explanation: received 为过去分词作后置定语，修饰 invoices，表被动“被收到的”。

questions.question: The new manager speaks ______ than her predecessor did.
questions.explanation: 句意为“比前任更自信”，需用比较级 more confidently 修饰动词 speaks。

questions.question: Neither the supervisor nor the trainees ______ aware of the policy change.
questions.explanation: neither...nor 就近原则，trainees 为复数，故用 were。

questions.question: We should ______ the meeting until our overseas partner confirms the schedule.
questions.explanation: should 后接动词原形，表“推迟”应用 postpone。

questions.question: The employee was praised for ______ the project ahead of schedule.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后接动名词 completing，表“因为完成……”。

questions.question: Not only ______ the deadline, but the team also stayed within budget.
questions.explanation: Not only 置于句首需部分倒装，助动词 did 提前，故用 did they meet。

questions.question: The shipment, ______ was scheduled for Monday, has been canceled.
questions.explanation: 非限定性定语从句修饰 shipment，用 which，且 which 作主语。

questions.question: Our firm has more clients ______ any of our local competitors.
questions.explanation: 比较级 more...than 搭配，表示“比任何本地竞争者都多”。

questions.question: The receptionist asked the caller ______ he might contact our customer service.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句需连词表“是否”，用 whether，后接陈述语序。

questions.question: Each representative ______ expected to submit the form by Friday.
questions.explanation: Each 作主语时用单数谓语 is，主谓一致。

questions.question: The contract was signed ______ the legal department had reviewed it twice.
questions.explanation: 句子意为“法律部门审阅两次之后合同才签署”，用 before 表“在……之前”。

questions.question: A well-written cover letter makes ______ easier for employers to assess your skills.
questions.explanation: make 后接形式宾语 it，指代后面的不定式 to assess your skills。

questions.question: The revised policy is ______ to the needs of part-time employees.
questions.explanation: specifically 表“专门地”，作副词修饰 is 的补语，符合句意。

questions.question: Please inform us in advance ______ you require a different delivery address.
questions.explanation: in case 表“以防、万一”，后接从句，符合商务邮件语境。

questions.question: The company ______ its warehouse to double storage capacity last year.
questions.explanation: last year 为过去时态标志，用过去完成 had expanded 表“已经扩建”。

questions.question: Hardly had the presentation ______ when questions flooded the room.
questions.explanation: Hardly had...when 结构，过去分词 begun 与 had 构成完成时，表“刚……就……”。

questions.question: The manager considers honesty ______ a key quality for every salesperson.
questions.explanation: consider...as 固定搭配，表“把……视为”。

questions.question: ______ the budget is confirmed, we will begin hiring new staff.
questions.explanation: Once 表“一旦”，条件状语从句，符合“预算确认后就招人”。

questions.question: The most effective way to improve service is ______ feedback from customers.
questions.explanation: be 动词后作表语用动名词 collecting，与主语 to improve 呼应。

questions.question: Our team's productivity has increased substantially ______ the new software was installed.
questions.explanation: since 表“自从”，主句用现在完成时 has increased，符合搭配。

questions.question: ______ the quarterly targets, only two regions met their sales goals.
questions.explanation: Regarding 作介词表“关于”，句首引出主题，符合商务报告语境。

questions.question: The auditors recommended that the firm ______ its accounting procedures.
questions.explanation: recommend 后接 that 从句用虚拟语气动词原形 revise。

questions.question: A larger advertising budget would allow us ______ a wider market share.
questions.explanation: allow sb to do 固定搭配，不定式 to capture 作宾语补足语。

questions.question: Fewer than half of the applicants ______ the required qualifications.
questions.explanation: 主语 applicants 为复数，谓语用复数形式 possess（此处指现状）。

questions.question: The CEO decided to ______ the annual conference to next spring.
questions.explanation: reschedule 表“重新安排时间”，符合“改期到明年春天”的语境。

questions.question: The software update, which fixed several errors, ______ released yesterday.
questions.explanation: 软件更新为单数主语，被动态过去时用 was released。

questions.question: Along with the contract, a confidentiality agreement ______ attached to the email.
questions.explanation: Along with 引出的短语不影响主谓一致，主语 agreement 单数用 is。

questions.question: Employees who arrive ______ than their scheduled shift may not be compensated.
questions.explanation: than 提示用比较级 earlier，修饰 arrive 表“更早到”。

questions.question: The purchasing department must ensure that every order ______ accurately recorded.
questions.explanation: ensure 后 that 从句可用虚拟语气动词原形 be，表“必须是”。

questions.question: ______ to the office, the courier handed the package to the receptionist.
questions.explanation: On/Upon + 动名词表“一……就……”，On arriving 表“一到办公室就……”。

questions.question: The sales figures this quarter are significantly lower ______ the same period last year.
questions.explanation: 比较级 lower 与 than 搭配，表“比去年同期低”。

questions.question: The engineer explained how the new system ______ in a matter of minutes.
questions.explanation: can be installed 为被动语态，表述“系统可被安装”，后不接多余代词。

questions.question: She has worked for this company ______ 2012.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时与 since 连用表“自2012年以来”，has worked 是时态标志。

questions.question: The committee must decide which proposal ______ the most benefit to the firm.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句主语 which proposal 为单数，用 brings 保持主谓一致。

questions.question: Not until the report was verified ______ the announcement public.
questions.explanation: Not until 置于句首引起部分倒装，did they make 符合倒装结构。

questions.question: Every applicant must ______ a detailed resume along with the application form.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 must 后接动词原形，表“必须提交”，用 submit。

questions.question: The training session will be held ______ the main conference room next Monday.
questions.explanation: 地点短语“in the conference room”表“在会议室里”，用介词 in。
